title: An Act to Authorize a General Fund Bond Issue to Establish the School Energy Savings Revolving Loan Fund (BOND ISSUE)

summary.text: This bill provides for a bond issue, in the amount of $10,000,000, to capitalize the School Energy Savings Revolving Loan Fund, which the bill establishes to support energy and energy efficiency projects in Maine schools to be administered by the Department of Education.
